NFL DFS Tight End Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 17, 11:30 AM ET

Brock Bowers is the top-projected tight end on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 18.4 DraftKings points for $7,500, against Buffalo. Trey McBride (16.5, $7,200) and Travis Kelce (14.2, $5,500) are next.

Tyler Higbee returns the most per dollar among tight ends projected for at least 7 points: 3.01 projected points per $1,000 at $3,400.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 17, 11:30 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Tight ends to know in Week 6

Brock Bowers, LV vs BUF ($7,500)

Brock Bowers carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 18.4 DraftKings points at $7,500. That is 2.0 points clear of Trey McBride. The model gives him 7.9 targets on 28.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.46 projected points per $1,000, 9th of 18 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Bowers averaged 18.3 points with a simulated floor of 7.1 and a ceiling of 38.0, and he holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Las Vegas is a 5.5-point underdog at home against Buffalo, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 53.5.

Trey McBride, ARI at LAR ($7,200)

Trey McBride projects 2nd at the position with 16.5 DraftKings points at $7,200. The model gives him 11.3 targets on 41.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.29 projected points per $1,000, 14th of 18 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McBride averaged 16.4 points with a simulated floor of 5.8 and a ceiling of 33.6, and he holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Arizona is a 12.5-point underdog on the road against the Rams, with an implied team total of 19.5 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Tyler Higbee, LAR vs ARI ($3,400)

Tyler Higbee projects for 10.2 DraftKings points at $3,400, which works out to 3.01 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 18 tight ends the model projects for 7 or more points. The model gives him 3.4 targets on 19.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Higbee averaged 10.3 points with a simulated floor of 2.1 and a ceiling of 24.8, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 12.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 32 in a game totaled at 51.5.
